primary: Confirmatory Pythia and OPT: mean of 8 paired step errors, K-only minus V-only at BF16 L1536 INT4 g32, separately prose/code and isolated/recurrent. Eight prespecified contrasts. L1536 plus 8 decode positions stays within their 2048-position limits. Other architectures/parameter probes exploratory.
uncertainty: Eight prespecified primary contrasts use 99.375% percentile source-block bootstrap intervals (20,000 resamples), nominal Bonferroni 95% family coverage. All other intervals exploratory. Approximate intervals, no power guarantee.
limitations: Dense resident intervention; no performance/capacity or whole-corpus quality evidence. Dense/full failures are retained separately. Models, tokens, heads and steps do not multiply independent source n.
